meta.name: knowledge-agent
meta.description: Build and query AI-powered knowledge bases from claude-mem observations. Use when users want to create focused "brains" from their observation history, ask questions about past work patterns, or compile expertise on specific topics.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从对话历史构建可查询的知识库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望从日常对话中自动提炼知识并随时查询
copy.tagline_en: Build queryable knowledge bases from conversation history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to automatically extract knowledge from daily conversations and query it anytime

howto.what: Claude 能把你的 claude-mem 观察记录按项目、类型、概念等条件筛成一份语料,加载成 AI 会话后,你可以像聊天一样向它提问,它依据这份语料作答,追问会保留上下文。
howto.when: 当你想从过往观察记录里建一个聚焦某个主题的知识库,或想就过去的工作模式、某类决策提问时触发。

say.text: 用 hooks 相关的观察记录建一个叫 hooks-expertise 的语料库
say.note: 按条件筛选并建立语料库

say.text: 加载 hooks-expertise,然后告诉我 5 个生命周期钩子分别何时触发
say.note: 加载语料并基于它作答

say.text: 列出我目前所有的语料库
say.note: 显示各语料库的统计和加载状态

howto.what_en: Claude filters your claude-mem observations by project, type, concepts and more into a corpus, loads it into an AI session, then answers your questions from that corpus and keeps context across follow-ups.
howto.when_en: Use when you want to build a focused knowledge base from your observation history, or ask about past work patterns and decisions on a topic.

say_en.text: Build a corpus named hooks-expertise from my hooks observations
say_en.note: filters observations and builds the corpus

say_en.text: Prime hooks-expertise, then tell me when the 5 lifecycle hooks fire
say_en.note: loads the corpus and answers from it
